applicationGuidance: Foliar spray of Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml per liter of water (500 ml in 200 liters water per acre) at first appearance of yellow rust pustules. Repeat spray after 15-20 days if weather remains cold and humid.
safetyInformation: Wear protective mask and gloves during spraying. Do not spray against wind. Observe a pre-harvest interval (PHI) of 30 days.
source: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal & UP Department of Agriculture
biologicalTreatment: Bio-fungicide application of Trichoderma viride @ 5g/liter as prophylactic spray early in the season.
culturalManagement: Avoid over-fertilization with urea. Drain excess standing water from wheat fields.

applicationGuidance: Spray Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml per liter of water (200 ml per acre in 200 liters water) upon initial detection of brown rust pustules.
safetyInformation: Do not allow livestock grazing in treated fields for 21 days after spray.
source: Chandra Shekhar Azad University of Agriculture & Technology (CSAUA&T), Kanpur
biologicalTreatment: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg seed.
culturalManagement: Maintain adequate row spacing for sunlight penetration.

applicationGuidance: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g per liter of water (120 g in 200 liters water per acre) at leaf blast onset. Repeat spray at boot leaf / 5% panicle emergence stage to prevent neck blast.
safetyInformation: Avoid fish contamination near paddy fields. Keep spray nozzle 30 cm above crop canopy.
source: ICAR - National Rice Research Institute (NRRI) & KVK Western UP
biologicalTreatment: Foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens (Pf-1 formulation) @ 2g/liter at 15-day intervals.
culturalManagement: Avoid excessive nitrogen application; apply potassium in two split doses.

applicationGuidance: Dissolve 500g Copper Oxychloride + 30g Streptocycline in 200 liters of water per acre. Spray twice at 10-12 days interval on crop appearance.
safetyInformation: Store Streptocycline packets in cool dry place. Do not mix with acidic fertilizers.
source: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology (ANDUAT), Ayodhya
biologicalTreatment: Soil application of Neem cake @ 100 kg/acre at field preparation.
culturalManagement: Drain standing water from infected fields for 3-4 days to arrest bacterial multiplication.

applicationGuidance: Red rot cannot be cured once inside standing cane. Prevention: Soak sugarcane setts in 0.1% Carbendazim solution (2g per liter water) for 15 minutes before planting.
safetyInformation: Wear rubber gloves while handling setts in chemical tank. Safely dispose solution away from water sources.
source: ICAR - Sugarcane Breeding Institute (SBI) & UP Cane Development Department
biologicalTreatment: Soil application of Trichoderma viride enriched FYM @ 5 kg T. viride mixed in 100 kg farmyard manure per acre at planting.
culturalManagement: Rogue out and burn infected clumps immediately. Do not take ratoon from affected field.

activeIngredient: Mancozeb 75% WP (Prophylactic) or Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Curative)
applicationGuidance: Prophylactic: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/liter (500g in 200L water/acre) before cloudy weather. Curative: Spray Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 3g/liter (600g/acre) upon first lesion detection.
safetyInformation: Observe 14-day Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI). Ensure complete under-leaf spray coverage.
source: ICAR - Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI), Shimla & KVK Agra/Farrukhabad
biologicalTreatment: Prophylactic spray of Bacillus subtilis bio-formulation @ 5 ml/liter water.
culturalManagement: Earthing up soil to 15 cm height around vines to prevent spore wash onto tubers.

applicationGuidance: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g per liter of water (400g per acre) at onset of concentric target spots on lower leaves. Repeat after 10-14 days.
safetyInformation: Toxic to aquatic organisms. Avoid spraying near open farm ponds.
source: UP Department of Agriculture & CPRI Field Extension
biologicalTreatment: Foliar spray of Neem Oil (10,000 ppm) @ 3 ml/liter water with sticker.
culturalManagement: Remove and burn lower infected foliage. Ensure balanced potash fertilization.

applicationGuidance: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g per liter water (500g per acre) 30-35 days after sowing if leaf lesions appear. Repeat spray after 12 days.
safetyInformation: Do not harvest green fodder within 14 days of fungicide application.
source: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR), Ludhiana & UP State Ag Directorate
biologicalTreatment: Seed dressing with Trichoderma harzianum @ 6g/kg seed.
culturalManagement: Destroy crop stubble post-harvest. Practice maize-legume crop rotation.

applicationGuidance: Spray Iprodione 50% WP @ 2g/liter or Mancozeb @ 2.5g/liter starting at 45 and 60 days after sowing (pod initiation phase) when dark circular spots appear.
safetyInformation: Avoid spraying during peak bee foraging hours (10 AM - 3 PM).
source: ICAR - Directorate of Rapeseed-Mustard Research (DRMR), Bharatpur & CSAUA&T Kanpur
biologicalTreatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10g/kg seed + foliar spray of Garlic extract 5% concentration.
culturalManagement: Sow crop before October 20th to bypass peak disease season.

disease: Fusarium Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. ciceris)
applicationGuidance: Wilt is soil-borne and cannot be controlled by foliar sprays. Dry seed treatment: Mix SAAF @ 2g per kg of chickpea seeds thoroughly before sowing.
safetyInformation: Treated seed is poisonous. Strictly do not use treated seed for food, feed, or oil.
source: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur
biologicalTreatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride formulation @ 10g/kg seed mixed with 5g Carboxin.
culturalManagement: Adopt 3-year crop rotation with wheat, sorghum, or mustard. Perform deep summer plowing.

applicationGuidance: Treat Arhar seeds with Vitavax Power @ 3g per kg seed prior to sowing to shield germinating seedlings from soil-borne vascular wilt fungi.
safetyInformation: Wear gloves. Keep treated seeds away from children and farm animals.
source: ICAR - IIPR Kanpur & UP Pulse Extension Division
biologicalTreatment: Soil application of Trichoderma harzianum @ 2.5 kg mixed with 50 kg well-decomposed FYM per acre applied in furrows.
culturalManagement: Intercrop with Sorghum (Jowar) in 1:2 ratio to suppress soil population of Fusarium udum.

applicationGuidance: No chemical pesticide or fungicide treatment is required. Continue balanced plant nutrition and regular field monitoring.
safetyInformation: Avoid prophylactic over-use of chemical pesticides on healthy crops.
source: Uttar Pradesh State Department of Agriculture
biologicalTreatment: Apply organic compost or Jeevamrut to promote beneficial soil microbes.
culturalManagement: Maintain clean field channels and weeds free bunds.
